title: Increment Patterns
concept: There are several ways to add or subtract 1 from a variable. Know your options and pick the clearest.
why: Adding 1 is the most common operation in programming. Knowing all the patterns helps you read and write code fluently.
tips: `x += 1` is the standard way to increment in most code
Use `x += n` for increments other than 1
Compound assignment works with any arithmetic: `+=`, `-=`, `*=`, `/=`, `%=`
Be consistent — pick one style and stick with it in a project
common_mistakes: Writing `x++` — XIOM doesn't have ++ or -- operators!
Mixing styles unnecessarily: sometimes `x = x + 1`, sometimes `x += 1`
